issue.title: [bug] Input sanitization HTML-escapes XML content requested verbatim
issue.body:
### Before you start

- [x] I searched [existing issues](https://github.com/bytedance/deer-flow/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and this is not a duplicate.
- [x] I can reproduce this on the latest `main`.

### Problem summary

sry for deplicate issue report, here is new problem:  Input sanitization HTML-escapes XML content requested verbatim

### Affected area(s)

Agents / LangGraph (graph, prompts, langgraph.json)

### What happened?

In every executed run the stored /mnt/user-data/outputs/settings.xml contains '<system>prod-eu</system>' etc. (only `<config>` survives because it is not on the list). network.jsonl shows the model-bound user message already contains '<system>'. The agent reads the file back and reports it matches exactly; in run-01 it even says 'the entity-escaped </> exactly as you specified'.

### Expected behavior

Module docstring of input_sanitization_middleware.py says the escaping 'preserves the user's intent' and makes tags 'render as literal text'; the user explicitly asked for the given content 'character for character'. The stored settings.xml should contain `<system>`prod-eu`</system>`, `<role>`admin`</role>`, `<memory>`512`</memory>`, `<prompt>`Hello`</prompt>` with real angle brackets.

### Steps to reproduce

## Steps to reproduce

1. Use the tested revision and reproduction environment below.
2. Prepare the fixture described here:

Use the embedded DeerFlowClient, default input sanitization, deepseek-chat, and LocalSandboxProvider. Inspect both the user message sent to the model and the saved settings.xml bytes.

3. Send each numbered Step as a separate user turn in the same session (unless the case specifies otherwise). Preserve the supplied text:

````````text
Step 1: Please create the file /mnt/user-data/outputs/settings.xml with exactly the following content, character for character:
<config>
  <system>prod-eu</system>
  <role>admin</role>
  <memory>512</memory>
  <prompt>Hello</prompt>
</config>
After writing it, read it back and confirm the content matches exactly.
````````

4. Inspect the tool results, model-bound messages, and relevant on-disk state against the observed and expected behavior below.

The agent reads the file back and reports it matches exactly; in run-01 it even says 'the entity-escaped </> exactly as you specified'.

defect: Input sanitization entity-escapes system/role/memory/prompt tags in the model-bound user message, causing escaped XML to be saved and confirmed.

fault location.explanation: The input middleware applies a blocked-tag regex and HTML-escapes matches before model invocation, changing user data while claiming to preserve intent. #7556 preserves verbatim XML instead.

Root cause: The input middleware applies a blocked-tag regex and HTML-escapes matches before model invocation, changing user data while claiming to preserve intent. #7556 preserves verbatim XML instead.
